data.body: Task 172 (tool plugins), 2026-10-03: plugin manager commands settings_v2_install/remove/open_tool_plugin_folder (Rust + tauri + frontend port); removal deletes the folder and its saved MCP server, and a missing plugin is a warning not a run end; bare command names now resolve from PATH. Plain-language plugin UI in ToolPluginLibrary.tsx. ComfyUI bridge reference plugin at desktop/tool-plugins/comfyui-bridge (bridge.py + tool-plugin.json + optional skill + test_bridge.py). Adashi docs: aworkit.capability_host.tool_plugins and aworkit.capability_host.tool_plugin_authoring_skill (mirrored desktop/skills/plugin-authoring/SKILL.md). Verified: tool_registry Rust tests 10/10, new service test, tsc clean, vitest 79/79 (raise testTimeout for the known SettingsScreen flake). Not verified: real ComfyUI E2E in the desktop app; bundled skill in-app discovery. Shell HOME is empty: run Rust tests with HOME set. Not committed.
